songs_to_prepare.title: Big Girls Don't Cry
songs_to_prepare.why: The signature Four Seasons sound — requires the authentic falsetto that defines this role

songs_to_prepare.title: Can't Take My Eyes Off You
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the tenor's full range from chest to falsetto — the climactic number every Frankie must nail

songs_to_prepare.title: Oh, What a Night
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows period pop tenor energy and the ability to carry the Four Seasons sound authentically

songs_to_prepare.title: How Deep Is Your Love
songs_to_prepare.composer: Barry Gibb / Maurice Gibb / Robin Gibb
songs_to_prepare.why: If period pop is accepted — shows the sweet falsetto tenor that Frankie Valli requires

jersey-boys/frankie-valli.style_guidance: Frankie Valli is the most technically specific role in jukebox musical theatre — a genuine falsetto to C6 is non-negotiable. The role cannot be faked. Voice first, acting follows.
avoid: Falsetto approximations — either you have the Frankie Valli voice or this is not the role for you

songs_to_prepare.title: My Way
songs_to_prepare.composer: Claude François / Jacques Revaux / Paul Anka
songs_to_prepare.why: If pop songs are accepted — Tommy's entire arc condensed, the unapologetic mobster who made it on his terms

songs_to_prepare.title: Luck Be a Lady
songs_to_prepare.why: Low baritone with swagger and criminal adjacent confidence — the street smart operator

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: Commanding baritone who leads through personality and intimidation — Tommy demanding his due

songs_to_prepare.title: Master of the House
songs_to_prepare.why: The charming operator who manipulates everyone around him through personality — Tommy's mode

jersey-boys/tommy-devito.style_guidance: Tommy is the dangerous charm at the heart of the Four Seasons story — low baritone with street authority and natural criminality. He needs to be persuasive enough that everyone keeps following him despite themselves.
avoid: Clean-cut or guileless energy — Tommy's appeal is his knowingness and implied threat

songs_to_prepare.title: Short People
songs_to_prepare.why: If pop songs accepted — the clever wit of the group's songwriter and intellectual heart

songs_to_prepare.title: Corner of the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: The young composer finding his place and his purpose — bright tenor who carries the harmony

songs_to_prepare.title: Till There Was You
songs_to_prepare.why: Period-adjacent lyric tenor — warm, clean, the emotional anchor of the group

jersey-boys/bob-gaudio.style_guidance: Bob Gaudio is the Four Seasons' moral compass and artistic engine — tenor with intelligence, steadiness, and the songwriting soul. He narrates a significant portion; clarity and warmth are essential.
avoid: Tommy's street energy — Bob is the deal-maker who keeps his word, the opposite of Tommy's chaos

songs_to_prepare.title: Old Man River
songs_to_prepare.why: Deep bass-baritone anchor — Nick is the low voice that grounds the Four Seasons harmony

songs_to_prepare.title: Some Enchanted Evening
songs_to_prepare.why: Rich bass-baritone romantic conviction — Nick as the quiet emotional core

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: Deep character bass-baritone with authority — shows the voice quality below the high tenor parts

jersey-boys/nick-massi.style_guidance: Nick Massi is the bass anchor of the group — the one in the background who eventually has had enough. Low voice, dry wit, and accumulating quiet resentment. He leaves without drama.
avoid: High register material — Nick's purpose is the deep harmonic foundation, not the top line

songs_to_prepare.title: Don't Rain on My Parade
songs_to_prepare.why: Jersey girl with a belt and no time for anyone's nonsense — street smart and completely undaunted

songs_to_prepare.title: Big Spender
songs_to_prepare.why: Period pop-adjacent belt — the kind of woman you meet in bars in the 1960s who is nobody's fool

songs_to_prepare.title: Losing My Mind
songs_to_prepare.why: Contrasting — shows the vulnerability beneath the tough exterior, what Tommy's mess actually costs her

jersey-boys/mary-delgado.style_guidance: Mary is the tough, loyal, eventually broken Jersey girlfriend — mezzo-soprano belt with attitude and a core of genuine pain. She loved Tommy before the money ruined everything.
avoid: Sweet or compliant material — Mary is a fighter who got unlucky in her choice of man

songs_to_prepare.title: Willkommen
songs_to_prepare.why: The theatrical music producer/industry figure — knowing, sophisticated, a gate to pass through

songs_to_prepare.title: I Am What I Am
songs_to_prepare.why: The fully realised, unapologetic character whose identity is entirely his own — Bob Crewe exactly

jersey-boys/jersey-bob-crewe.style_guidance: Bob Crewe is the flamboyant music producer who believes in the group — theatrical tenor/baritone with wit and industry confidence. He is camp and effective. His confidence opens the door.
avoid: Straight, square energy — Crewe's theatricality is part of his brand and his gift

songs_to_prepare.title: Old Man River
songs_to_prepare.why: The deep authority of a man who actually runs things — bass/bass-baritone with genuine weight

songs_to_prepare.title: Some Enchanted Evening
songs_to_prepare.why: Bass-baritone who commands rooms through presence alone — the benevolent mob boss

jersey-boys/jersey-gyp-decarlo.style_guidance: Gyp DeCarlo is the mob patron who keeps Tommy in check — low bass/baritone with genuine physical authority. Warm to Frankie, cold to everyone who causes trouble. A supporting role that reads as power.
avoid: Theatrical villainy — Gyp is measured, respected, and quietly terrifying precisely because he is not theatrical

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: The neighbourhood kid who connects the group — character tenor with street energy and personality

jersey-boys/jersey-joe-pesci.style_guidance: Joey Pesci is a supporting character role — the connector who brings the Four Seasons together. Tenor with street energy and the ability to make an impression quickly.
avoid: Heavy leading material — this is a featured supporting character who serves the plot

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: Character baritone in an industry role — the obstacle/helper figure in the music business

jersey-boys/jersey-norm-waxman.style_guidance: Norm Waxman is a record label/music industry supporting character — baritone with authority and the specific polished cool of 1960s music business. A small role requiring presence.
avoid: Over-large choices — Norm is a supporting industry role, not a scene-stealer

songs_to_prepare.title: Far From the Home I Love
songs_to_prepare.why: The daughter caught between worlds — soprano/mezzo with love and pain in equal measure

songs_to_prepare.title: Children Will Listen
songs_to_prepare.why: Contrasting — about what parents teach children, and what the cost of that is

jersey-boys/jersey-francine.style_guidance: Francine is Frankie's troubled daughter — soprano/mezzo who carries the personal cost of the Four Seasons' success. Her tragedy is the show's emotional low point. Small but devastating role.
avoid: Bright or upbeat material — Francine is grief waiting to happen

songs_to_prepare.title: Big Spender
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman in the orbit of famous men — soprano/mezzo with period pop energy and survivalism

jersey-boys/jersey-lorraine.style_guidance: Lorraine is a supporting female role in the world of the Four Seasons — one of the women who passes through. Soprano/mezzo with 1960s character and the ability to register quickly.
avoid: Heavy roles — Lorraine is a passing encounter, vibrant but brief

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: The older De Vito brother — character tenor with street energy and affectionate comic menace

jersey-boys/jersey-nick-devito.style_guidance: Nick DeVito is Tommy's older brother — the original group member who makes way for the real Four Seasons. Tenor with neighborhood character. Supporting role.
avoid: Leading man energy — Nick steps aside and that gracious exit defines him

songs_to_prepare.title: Oh, What a Night
songs_to_prepare.why: The pre-Gaudio member — shows the original Four Seasons sound before the transformation

jersey-boys/jersey-hank-majewski.style_guidance: Hank Majewski is the outgoing member when Gaudio joins — tenor who forms part of the original group. Small role requiring period harmony skills.
avoid: Stand-out soloistic material — Hank is ensemble, his role is defined by the harmony not the spotlight

songs_to_prepare.title: Sherry
songs_to_prepare.why: The Four Seasons' first hit — shows ability to sing in tight period pop harmony

songs_to_prepare.title: Runaround Sue
songs_to_prepare.why: If period pop is accepted — shows the doo-wop/early rock harmony skills the show demands

jersey-boys/ensemble-jersey.style_guidance: Jersey Boys ensemble are multi-track performers playing many roles — period pop/rock voices, the ability to harmonise in the doo-wop style, and strong character-switching throughout.
avoid: Contemporary pop-only voices — the show requires authentic 1960s pop harmony sensibility

songs_to_prepare.title: Waving Through a Window
songs_to_prepare.why: Contemporary teen anxiety and outsider identity — the specific flavour of Percy before he discovers himself

songs_to_prepare.title: Good for You
songs_to_prepare.why: Contemporary teen pop-rock tenor with building intensity — Percy in conflict

songs_to_prepare.title: Stranger
songs_to_prepare.why: Percy's own opening song — shows the specific rock tenor the show requires

songs_to_prepare.title: Michael in the Bathroom
songs_to_prepare.why: Contemporary teen boy rock isolation — the ADHD outsider who is about to discover he is extraordinary

lightning-thief/percy.style_guidance: Percy is a contemporary pop-rock leading tenor — ADHD, impulsive, brave, and deeply loyal. The voice needs rock energy and teenage rawness. This is not a legit show.
avoid: Classical or Golden Age style — The Lightning Thief is contemporary rock musical through and through

songs_to_prepare.title: Defying Gravity
songs_to_prepare.why: The most intelligent person in the room who still has to fight for her place — mezzo belt with conviction

songs_to_prepare.title: What I Need
songs_to_prepare.why: Annabeth's own moment — shows the specific rock mezzo the show requires

songs_to_prepare.title: Warrior
songs_to_prepare.why: If contemporary songs accepted — the warrior girl who fights with her brain and will not back down

songs_to_prepare.title: I Know the Truth
songs_to_prepare.why: Mezzo-soprano with intelligence and conviction — Annabeth when events exceed expectation

lightning-thief/annabeth.style_guidance: Annabeth is the smartest character in the show and she knows it — mezzo-soprano with rock belt and intellectual authority. She does not need rescuing. She does the rescuing.
avoid: Passive or sweet material — Annabeth is decisive, analytical, and formidable

songs_to_prepare.title: Corner of the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: The young man searching for his purpose and worth — Grover looking for Pan in musical form

songs_to_prepare.title: I Believe
songs_to_prepare.composer: Trey Parker / Matt Stone / Robert Lopez
songs_to_prepare.why: Earnest commitment to a mission despite self-doubt — Grover's entire character in three minutes

songs_to_prepare.title: Not While I'm Around
songs_to_prepare.why: Contrasting — shows the genuine protective love beneath Grover's anxiety

lightning-thief/grover.style_guidance: Grover is the anxious, loving best friend who desperately wants his searcher's license — baritone/tenor with warmth, physical comedy, and genuine emotional investment in Percy's safety.
avoid: Cool, confident performance — Grover is perpetually unsure of himself, and that is exactly why we love him

songs_to_prepare.title: Giants in the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: A young man who went out into the world, found it unfair, and came back changed — Luke's whole arc

songs_to_prepare.title: Anthem
songs_to_prepare.why: Passionate baritone who believes the system is corrupt and is taking action — exactly Luke's manifesto

songs_to_prepare.title: Epiphany
songs_to_prepare.why: The moment a bitter man decides to act on his fury — dark, precise, and chilling in its conviction

lightning-thief/luke.style_guidance: Luke is the betrayed golden child turned antagonist — low baritone with intensity and the specific quality of someone who was genuinely wronged and cannot stop. His anger is understandable, which is what makes it dangerous.
avoid: Pure villain energy — Luke's power is that he is right about the gods being unjust, he just handles it catastrophically

songs_to_prepare.title: So Big/So Small
songs_to_prepare.why: The mother who did everything she could and still could not protect her child from the world

songs_to_prepare.title: Far From the Home I Love
songs_to_prepare.why: A mother watching her child leave for a dangerous world — warmth, courage, and devastating love

songs_to_prepare.title: Children Will Listen
songs_to_prepare.why: About what mothers teach children, knowingly or not — mezzo with depth and protective love

lightning-thief/sally-jackson.style_guidance: Sally Jackson is the mother who chose love over safety and will do it again — contemporary mezzo-soprano with warmth, strength, and the specific courage of single parenthood in impossible circumstances.
avoid: Passive maternal warmth — Sally is intensely protective and would do anything for Percy

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: The reluctant authority figure with contempt for everyone around him — character baritone comedy

songs_to_prepare.title: I've Got a Little List
songs_to_prepare.why: The god who resents being in charge of demigod brats — sarcastic omnipotence finds patter song perfect

lightning-thief/lt-mr-d.style_guidance: Mr. D is a god doing camp counsellor as punishment — contemptuous baritone with magnificent comic disdain. He is genuinely omnipotent and cannot be bothered. Every line should feel like an eye-roll.
avoid: Engaged or enthusiastic character — Dionysus's entire comedy is spectacular, theatrical indifference

songs_to_prepare.title: Make Them Hear You
songs_to_prepare.why: The teacher/mentor who prepares warriors — baritone with gravitas and genuine belief in his students

songs_to_prepare.title: Sunrise, Sunset
songs_to_prepare.why: The ancient figure watching a child leave the nest knowing what lies ahead — warm, paternal baritone

lightning-thief/lt-chiron.style_guidance: Chiron is the great mentor — warm baritone with the weight of ancient wisdom and genuine love for his students. He knows what's coming and must send them anyway.
avoid: Detached or cold material — Chiron cares deeply even when he cannot show it

songs_to_prepare.title: You Can't Stop the Beat
songs_to_prepare.why: Unstoppable, aggressive, competitive force — alto/mezzo with pure dominant energy

songs_to_prepare.title: Everything's Coming Up Roses
songs_to_prepare.why: Someone who will crush whatever stands between her and her goal — forceful mezzo-soprano

lightning-thief/lt-clarisse.style_guidance: Clarisse is the bully who is eventually more complex — alto/mezzo with physical aggression and the ability to show unexpected vulnerability when pushed. She is defined by competition.
avoid: Gentle or lyric approach — Clarisse opens doors with her fist, not a key

songs_to_prepare.title: Somewhere That's Green
songs_to_prepare.why: The romantic who wants something simple and beautiful — mezzo-soprano with warmth and idealism

songs_to_prepare.title: I Feel Pretty
songs_to_prepare.why: Love-struck mezzo-soprano glowing with uncomplicated happiness — before the complications

lightning-thief/lt-silena.style_guidance: Silena is a supporting character — mezzo-soprano with warmth and romantic idealism. Her arc has depth when the show's backstory is explored.
avoid: Heavy material — Silena is a supporting role, not a lead

songs_to_prepare.title: Master of the House
songs_to_prepare.why: The unearned authority figure who exploits everyone around him — character baritone comedy with menace

songs_to_prepare.title: I've Got the Horse Right Here
songs_to_prepare.why: The blustering, entitled character who everyone else endures — comedy through total self-assurance

lightning-thief/lt-gabe.style_guidance: Gabe is the abusive stepfather played for comedy and contempt — character baritone with enough theatricality to make the audience hate-laugh. He must be genuinely unpleasant but navigated with theatrical craft.
avoid: Sympathetic energy — Gabe is meant to be deeply satisfying when dealt with by Medusa

songs_to_prepare.title: The Lady Is a Tramp
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman who shows one face and means another — mezzo-soprano with the ability to flip terrifyingly

songs_to_prepare.title: Nothing
songs_to_prepare.why: Character mezzo — good teacher front concealing something predatory

lightning-thief/lt-mrs-dodds.style_guidance: Mrs. Dodds is the monster in teacher's clothing — mezzo/alto who plays warmth until the mask comes off. The shock of the transformation is everything. Dual nature, physical commitment.
avoid: Obvious villain energy from the start — the reveal must be a genuine surprise

songs_to_prepare.title: Epiphany
songs_to_prepare.why: Pure, controlled homicidal purpose — baritone who enjoys what he does and does not hide it

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: Commanding baritone who exists to create conflict — Ares as the force of belligerence in a room

lightning-thief/lt-ares.style_guidance: Ares is the god who wants war and is delighted by it — baritone with genuine menace and physical authority. He should be genuinely frightening while being undeniably cool.
avoid: Comedic treatment — Ares is one of the show's genuine threats, not played for laughs

songs_to_prepare.title: I Am What I Am
songs_to_prepare.why: A creature defined by what was done to her who refuses to apologise for surviving it

songs_to_prepare.title: The Saga of Jennie
songs_to_prepare.why: The theatrical woman with a complicated history and considerable power — mezzo with dramatic presence

lightning-thief/lt-medusa.style_guidance: Medusa in this show is sympathetic as well as monstrous — a woman wronged by the gods who turned the rules to her advantage. Mezzo-soprano with dramatic presence and a gift for playing warmth-as-predation.
avoid: Pure monster — Medusa's tragedy is that her victims come to her willingly because she is charming

songs_to_prepare.title: Good for You
songs_to_prepare.why: Contemporary pop-rock ensemble energy — the show's sound is rock musical, ensemble must match

songs_to_prepare.title: Defying Gravity
songs_to_prepare.why: Contemporary belt with rock adjacent power — shows the ensemble range the show requires

lightning-thief/ensemble-gods.style_guidance: The Lightning Thief ensemble plays an enormous variety — gods, monsters, camp counsellors, and mythological creatures. Contemporary pop-rock voices with physical versatility and character range.
avoid: Period or legit style — this show is written in contemporary rock musical language

songs_to_prepare.title: A Spoonful of Sugar
songs_to_prepare.composer: Richard M. Sherman / Robert B. Sherman
songs_to_prepare.why: The character's most famous number — shows the crisp, bright soprano quality and cheerful authority

songs_to_prepare.title: Practically Perfect
songs_to_prepare.why: The stage version's character introduction — shows the precision and dry wit the role requires

songs_to_prepare.title: My Favourite Things
songs_to_prepare.why: Warm soprano with specific opinions and domestic authority — precision and warmth

songs_to_prepare.title: Anything You Can Do
songs_to_prepare.why: Soprano with absolute conviction of superiority and no tolerance for being second — exactly Mary

mary-poppins/mary-poppins.style_guidance: Mary Poppins is practically perfect — soprano who is warm but never soft, authoritative but never cold, comic but entirely sincere about her own perfection. Crisp diction is non-negotiable.
avoid: Gushing or sentimental approach — Mary Poppins is not sentimental; she is magical and pragmatic

songs_to_prepare.title: Step in Time
songs_to_prepare.composer: Richard M. Sherman / Robert B. Sherman
songs_to_prepare.why: Bert's big physical number — baritone/tenor with dance energy and warmth for the children

songs_to_prepare.title: Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious
songs_to_prepare.composer: Richard M. Sherman / Robert B. Sherman
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the fun, versatile, audience-connecting quality Bert needs

songs_to_prepare.title: Make Someone Happy
songs_to_prepare.why: Warm baritone/tenor who genuinely wants others to flourish — Bert's soul in a single song

songs_to_prepare.title: There's Gotta Be Something Better Than This
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the working-class optimist who believes in magic and dreams — Bert's philosophical foundation

mary-poppins/bert.style_guidance: Bert is the warm, magnetic link between Mary's world and ours — baritone/tenor who is profoundly likeable, physically extraordinary (tap and acrobatics are expected), and genuine in his warmth.
avoid: Cynicism or world-weariness — Bert is pure optimism and delight in every scene

songs_to_prepare.title: The Road You Didn't Take
songs_to_prepare.why: A man who chose order over feeling and slowly pays for it — the Banks redemption arc in music form

songs_to_prepare.title: Soliloquy
songs_to_prepare.why: The father confronting his responsibilities and his love for his children — baritone with genuine stakes

songs_to_prepare.title: Being Alive
songs_to_prepare.why: The man who has organised his life to avoid feeling and is beginning to understand the cost

mary-poppins/george-banks.style_guidance: George Banks begins as a control-obsessed stuffed shirt and becomes a real father — baritone who must carry both the comedy of rigidity and the genuine emotional transformation. The audience's affection depends on seeing the real man inside.
avoid: One-note cold/uptight performance — George must be sympathetic even at his worst, or the arc means nothing

songs_to_prepare.title: Castle on a Cloud
songs_to_prepare.why: A lonely, imaginative child dreaming of warmth and understanding — Jane's unspoken longing

songs_to_prepare.title: My Favourite Things
songs_to_prepare.why: Bright, clear child soprano with intelligence — the daughter who needs something to believe in

mary-poppins/jane-banks.style_guidance: Jane is the Banks child with the sharper mind and the deeper longing — child soprano with intelligence and genuine emotional awareness. She is often the first to understand what Mary is really teaching.
avoid: Loud or scene-grabbing choices — Jane's power is in observation and quiet understanding

songs_to_prepare.title: Tomorrow
songs_to_prepare.why: The optimistic child who bounces back from everything — bright treble, genuine warmth

songs_to_prepare.title: Where Is Love
songs_to_prepare.why: The child who simply wants to be loved and seen — sweet treble with emotional simplicity

mary-poppins/michael-banks.style_guidance: Michael is the child who acts up because he wants attention — treble with natural comedy and genuine sweetness underneath the mischief. His transformation should feel real, not just cute.
avoid: Playing Michael as purely naughty — there is a lonely child underneath every tantrum

songs_to_prepare.title: Far From the Home I Love
songs_to_prepare.why: A woman who gave up her identity for her marriage and is slowly reclaiming it — mezzo with warmth and courage

songs_to_prepare.title: What I Did for Love
songs_to_prepare.why: Simple, genuine mezzo feeling — Winifred choosing her family with full knowledge of the cost

songs_to_prepare.title: Being Good Isn't Good Enough
songs_to_prepare.why: A woman who did everything right and is not getting her due — mezzo with restrained frustration

mary-poppins/winifred-banks.style_guidance: Winifred is the secret anchor of Cherry Tree Lane — mezzo-soprano who has made herself small and must learn to take up space again. Warm, intelligent, quietly brave.
avoid: Doormat performance — Winifred is capable of tremendous strength, she has just forgotten

songs_to_prepare.title: I've Got a Little List
songs_to_prepare.why: The joyfully disapproving authority figure who catalogues everyone's failures — the anti-Mary Poppins

songs_to_prepare.title: Ol' Man River
songs_to_prepare.why: Dark, rolling mezzo/alto power — Miss Andrew as force of nature and oppression

songs_to_prepare.title: Everything's Coming Up Roses
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman certain of her own correctness — mezzo belt with absolute conviction of righteousness

mary-poppins/miss-andrew.style_guidance: Miss Andrew is Mary Poppins's dark mirror — the nanny who uses fear instead of love, power instead of magic. Mezzo/alto powerhouse, deeply physical, genuinely terrifying to the children.
avoid: Comedic buffoon approach — Miss Andrew is the show's legitimate monster before she gets her comeuppance

songs_to_prepare.title: Feed the Birds
songs_to_prepare.composer: Richard M. Sherman / Robert B. Sherman
songs_to_prepare.why: The Bird Woman's own gentle anthem — alto with warmth, dignity, and the weight of being overlooked

songs_to_prepare.title: What I Did for Love
songs_to_prepare.why: Simple, heartfelt alto — a woman who has chosen love as her life's work without regret

mary-poppins/bird-woman.style_guidance: The Bird Woman is simplicity and wisdom in one small role — alto with inner peace and the gentleness of someone who has let the world pass by. Every word counts. Shows what authentic goodness sounds like.
avoid: Heavy or dramatic material — the Bird Woman is quiet holiness, not grandeur

songs_to_prepare.title: Glitter and Be Gay
songs_to_prepare.why: The theatrical mysterious shopkeeper — soprano with magic and theatrical excess

songs_to_prepare.title: The Saga of Jennie
songs_to_prepare.why: The knowing, ancient theatrical woman who moves outside normal time — soprano character presence

mary-poppins/mrs-corry.style_guidance: Mrs Corry is the magical shopkeeper who exists slightly outside of time — soprano/mezzo with warmth and theatrical mystery. A featured supporting role in the show's fantastical world.
avoid: Ordinary or grounded character work — Mrs Corry is connected to Mary's world of magic

songs_to_prepare.title: Adelaide's Lament
songs_to_prepare.why: The long-suffering character mezzo who has seen too much and endures too many — the Cook's lament

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: Character mezzo with timing and comic earthiness — Mrs Brill managing chaos with resigned dignity

mary-poppins/mrs-brill.style_guidance: Mrs Brill is the harried Cook — alto/mezzo with broad comedy, physicality, and the enduring warmth of a woman who keeps the household running against all odds.
avoid: Refined or elegant material — Mrs Brill is resolutely below stairs and proud of it

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: The character who exists to be confused and get things wrong — tenor/baritone physical comedy

mary-poppins/robertson-ay.style_guidance: Robertson Ay is the perpetually confused, accident-prone handyman — tenor/baritone character role, broad physical comedy, and the ability to deliver chaos with complete sincerity.
avoid: Competent energy — Robertson Ay's defining trait is lovable incompetence

songs_to_prepare.title: Children Will Listen
songs_to_prepare.why: The statue come to life — tenor with wonder at a world he has watched but never touched

mary-poppins/neleus.style_guidance: Neleus is the park statue brought to life by Mary Poppins — tenor speciality role requiring physicality (marble stillness transitioning to life) and a quality of discovered wonder.
avoid: Naturalistic movement — Neleus has been stone; every movement should carry the memory of it

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: The frustrated authority figure whose rules are constantly flouted — character tenor/baritone with exasperation

mary-poppins/park-keeper.style_guidance: The Park Keeper is a comic supporting character — character tenor/baritone whose entire purpose is maintaining ORDER in a park that will not cooperate. Exasperation is the character note.
avoid: Heavy material — this is a light supporting comic role

mary-poppins/ensemble-poppins.role_name: Ensemble — Chimney Sweeps, Park Strollers, Statues, Toys, Bank Staff

songs_to_prepare.title: Step in Time
songs_to_prepare.composer: Richard M. Sherman / Robert B. Sherman
songs_to_prepare.why: The show's big tap number — dance skills are as important as voice for this ensemble

songs_to_prepare.title: Anything Goes
songs_to_prepare.why: Period-style ensemble energy — charm, precision, and period show style

songs_to_prepare.title: There's No Business Like Show Business
songs_to_prepare.why: Showbiz ensemble who must transform into many types within the show's physical world

mary-poppins/ensemble-poppins.style_guidance: Mary Poppins ensemble must dance-sing-act at a high level — tap technique especially important. They play many worlds: the working-class Edwardian street, the magical interiors, and the stuffy bank.
avoid: Contemporary vocal style — this is a period-style ensemble requirement
